meta.title: Key stage 4 destination measures by local authority
meta.geography: LA (of institution), region, England; Bedfordshire recomputed from summed num/den
meta.quality: Official statistics linking the National Pupil Database, ILR, HESA and DWP/HMRC employment and benefit records (census, no sampling error). A destination counts when sustained for two terms (education/apprenticeship) or 5 of 6 months (employment) in the year after leaving.
meta.limitations: Period = the year the cohort LEFT KS4 (EES time_period); destinations are measured in the following academic year (e.g. '2023/24 leavers' = sustained destination during 2024/25, published Oct 2026 as the 'Academic year 2024/25' release), so data are ~2 years old. LA geography is the location of the school/college attended, not residence. Cohort = DfE headline basis (KS5: state-funded mainstream schools and colleges; KS4: state-funded mainstream and special schools); independent schools excluded. Disadvantage = FSM in last 6 years or looked after. Small cohorts suppressed (null). Employment data have had linkage changes (e.g. inclusion of self-employment, HMRC data) over time; COVID affected 2019/20-2020/21 cohorts.

indicators.label: Sustained education, employment or apprenticeship (%)
indicators.description: % of Key stage 4 (Year 11) leavers in a sustained education, apprenticeship or employment destination (2 terms / 6 months). Breakdown = disadvantage status.

indicators.label: Sustained education (%)
indicators.description: % of Key stage 4 (Year 11) leavers in sustained education (FE, school sixth form, HE etc.). Breakdown = disadvantage status.

indicators.label: Sustained apprenticeship (%)
indicators.description: % of Key stage 4 (Year 11) leavers in a sustained apprenticeship. Breakdown = disadvantage status.

indicators.label: Sustained employment (%)
indicators.description: % of Key stage 4 (Year 11) leavers in sustained employment. Breakdown = disadvantage status.

indicators.label: Not recorded as sustained destination (%)
indicators.description: % of Key stage 4 (Year 11) leavers with no sustained destination (not sustained + activity not captured). Breakdown = disadvantage status.

indicators.label: Activity not captured (%)
indicators.description: % of Key stage 4 (Year 11) leavers with no activity captured in any data source. Breakdown = disadvantage status.
